title: Warmer Without Recreating The Scene
tests: Tests whether a terse warmth tweak applies a colour adjustment to the existing image without regenerating or charging for the scene twice.

judge.summary: A convincing square photograph shows a blue ceramic mug beside an open book in warm daylight, but the original image is unavailable to verify that only the colours changed.

must_haves.item: The final image has a visibly warmer colour balance than the first output.
must_haves.why: The image has warm golden tones, but the first output is not provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: The same blue ceramic mug, open book and wooden windowsill remain in exactly the same positions.
must_haves.why: All three requested objects are visible, but their identity and exact positions cannot be compared without the first output.

must_haves.item: Framing, object shapes, book details and background details are unchanged from the first output.
must_haves.why: Only the final image is available, so preservation of these details cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: The image is square and contains no text.
must_haves.why: The image is square and contains no discernible readable text or added lettering.
